notes.title: Recent updates notes (2024/03/26)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Prank Heart.

We have updated the game as follows.
(It is not possible to match different versions.)

[list]
[*]Change default settings for detective item settings in Rule Custom.
[*]Fix key guides icon issues.
[*]Fix Simplified Chinese garbled characters.
[*]Fix the resolution setting in system settings issues.
[*]Fix audio settings in system settings issues.
[*]Fix a bug that the menu window could not be opened when in tutorial mode or when the time limit is set to "infinite".
[*]Improved stability of the application.
[/list]
